description: This PHP script handles AJAX requests related to network device management, specifically processing form data to set or get configurations such as bridge mode and IGMP snooping. It includes utility functions and performs server-side validation before updating device settings and returning JSON responses.

methods.name: isValInArray
methods.description: Checks if a value exists within an array

methods.name: setStr
methods.description: Sets a configuration string on the device

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration string from the device
